shorts.title: What you will learn: const references
shorts.hook: Look, but do not touch. That is a const reference.
shorts.script: Look, but do not touch. That is a const reference. Today we learn the most common parameter style in modern C plus plus. It is fast, and it is safe. Copying a big string for every call is slow. A reference avoids the copy. But a reference lets the function change the original. Add const, and the function may only read it. Keep coding, says Xecxec!
shorts.caption: What you will learn: const references.

shorts.title: const references in one minute
shorts.hook: Copying a big string for every call is slow.
shorts.script: Copying a big string for every call is slow. A reference avoids the copy. But a reference lets the function change the original. Add const, and the function may only read it. So a const reference is fast and safe. Think of a museum. You may look at the painting, but you may not touch it. The parameter is a const reference to a string. Keep coding, says Xecxec!
shorts.caption: const references in one minute.

shorts.title: Inside the second program
shorts.script: Both parameters are const references. Both strings are only read. The function compares the sizes. Panjim and Mapusa both have six letters, so the answer is false. A const reference can also take a plain quoted text. Margao is longer than Goa, so the answer is true. The program prints false and then true. A copy of a big value is slow. Keep coding, says Xecxec!
shorts.caption: Inside the second program.

shorts.title: Bug of the Day: Changing a const reference
shorts.hook: Can you spot the bug in const references?
shorts.script: Can you spot the bug in const references? Bug of the Day. The function takes a const reference, and then tries to add one. The compiler says increment of read-only reference. Const means look, but do not touch. If the function must change the value, remove const. A const reference is read-only. If the function must change the value, use a plain reference. Keep coding, says Xecxec!
shorts.caption: Bug of the Day: Changing a const reference.
